policy: Minor LLA + soft self loss; last-2 narrow gate and cross masks unchanged
self_loss_denominator: baseline selected self mask count before suppression
gate_note: Argmax eligibility only. minor_selected_target describes an argmax, not the actual soft training target. Actual suppression is logged in correction_gate_stats.csv.
rate_denominator: n within each condition; rates are fractions, not percentages
validation_index: position in deterministic validation split for this seed
limitations: Clean validation images in eval mode; not actual augmented train batches. Confidence gaps are descriptive, not calibrated reliability scores. Do not fit a rule and report its accuracy on these same validation samples.
